Every oxrok binary links Rust's standard library statically: std, core,
alloc, compiler_builtins and the crates they depend on, among them
addr2line, cfg-if, gimli, hashbrown, libc, memchr, miniz_oxide, object,
rustc-demangle and unicode-width. No crate declares them, so cargo-about
does not list them.

Copyright (c) The Rust Project Contributors. Licensed under the Apache
License, Version 2.0, or the MIT license, at your option; both texts are
in the crate list above. Some of the crates are also under other
permissive terms; the toolchain's share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html
lists them all, for the toolchain the release was built with.

The Linux musl binaries also link LLVM's libunwind, from Rust's own
target libraries: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, Copyright (c) the LLVM
Project contributors. The exception's text is in the crate list above
when a listed crate uses it, and at https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt.

The Windows binary links Microsoft's C runtime statically, as a system
library of the platform, with no third-party licence text to reproduce
here.
